ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture Characters（中世日本 - 文化・人物）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture Characters adapts pawn backgrounds and traits for ancient-to-medieval Japanese play. It rewrites existing backgrounds, restricts anachronistic ordinary pawn generation, and adjusts selected starting possessions while preserving existing BackstoryDef and TraitDef identities. Harmony is required. Medieval Overhaul is optional. A new game is recommended. Do not co-install with an older unsplit AMJ Culture build, which duplicates generation rules. With current separated Culture, scoped RimWorld Vanilla 1.6 and 1.7 game tests passed. This is unpublished development software; original MO combination and legacy-save compatibility remain unverified.
中世日本に合わせて人物の背景・特性と通常生成を調整する。既存背景の名称・説明、時代に合わない背景・特性の通常生成制限、初期所持品の置換を扱い、既存のBackstoryDef・TraitDefの識別子は保持する。Harmony必須、Medieval Overhaul任意。新規ゲーム推奨。分離前の旧Cultureには同じ人物生成規則が含まれるため同時導入しない。分離済みの現行Cultureとは任意に併用可能で、RimWorld Vanilla 1.6・1.7の限定実ゲーム検証を通過。MO同時導入・旧セーブ互換は未検証。公開前の開発版。
